name: axhub
description: Claude Code plugin for axhub. Natural-language axhub requests should route to one of onboarding/bootstrap/deploy/import/development/diagnosis/update before ordinary Code-mode shell work; clarity is manual/explicit-only for exact CLI ops like logs/env/rollback/table/connector/GitHub reconnect. Routing priority is strict: if a prompt asks axhub 최신, 버전 확인, 업데이트, latest, up to date, version check, update, or upgrade, invoke the axhub update skill first; first visible assistant text is exactly `현재 버전을 확인할게요.` A narrow Code-mode update router reinforces this contract through SessionStart context plus a UserPromptSubmit match when freshness words appear; it adds routing context only, not commands. This includes mixed prompts like `명령어는 잘 몰라. axhub가 진짜 최신인지 먼저 확인해주고, 내 앱들이 지금 어떤 상태인지도 알아서 봐줘. 그다음 새 앱 만들어서 실제로 배포까지 해줘.` After update, continue app status/create/deploy in the same conversation, and for app status overview use exact `axhub apps --help` then `axhub apps list --json`, never nonexistent `axhub app list` and never pipes or redirects. Never start freshness prompts with `Using /axhub:clarity`, run scripts, shell/version probes, app-status tools, Claude Desktop axhub App/MCP tools, clarity, bootstrap, deploy, /oh-my-claudecode:autopilot, unrelated plugin modes, or generic Code-mode handling. Korean-first skills call ax-hub-cli v0.20.0+ surfaces directly, with preview-confirm deploy, verify-based success, existing-app import, read-only diagnosis, and CLI-only manual clarity.
